edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire total supply to msg.sender

Early sell tax branch compares _holderFirstBuyTimestamp with block.timestamp, making fees miner-influenceable
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap addLiquidity deadline
The owner-only exemption in _transfer limits checks for the owner address
